about: The angel completes the account of the pearl: Zion went with the firstborn David (Menelik) to Ethiopia, while the pearl was carried into Jeroboam’s line, from which the saviour will be born; Gabriel, Michael and Uriel are assigned as guardians of Solomon’s three sons, and the tree of the cross is foretold. Solomon bows down, thanks God, and says he no longer fears death, Sheol or scattering, because his soul will be with David, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob when the saviour brings them out.

sentences.l: For the-pearl is-carried (?) in-males who you-are righteous, and-women-also who carried burden-of pearl not-will-be-lost-they, for pure they-will-be in-that pearl, for holy and-pure she, and-by-her you-are-sanctified and-you-become-clean;
sentences.i: For the pearl is carried (?) by the men among you who are righteous; and the women who carried the burden of the pearl will not be lost, for they will be pure in her, the pearl, since she is holy and pure, and by her you are sanctified and become clean;
sentences.n: The one image of the whole chapter is ባሕርይ ‘the pearl’, the line of descent that carries the saviour; ch. 68 part 1 ends with the promise that none of its carriers is lost, and this unit explains why. ትጸወር as written is the active 3fs (or 2ms) imperfect or subjunctive of ጾረ ‘carry’ (the fidäl does not mark doubling); the passive ‘is carried’, with ባሕርይ as its subject and በተባዕት ‘in/by males’ as the carriers, would be the tä-stem, which has one more ት in the 3fs, so I take ‘is carried’ only by supposing that a ት has dropped out (a haplography) (?). The alternative is the active, ‘(you) carry the pearl in males who …’ (?). I keep ‘is carried’ because the pearl is throughout the thing carried (?). ትከውኑ is 2mp (‘you … are’), so the angel is addressing Solomon’s line directly. ወአንስትሂ = ወ- + አንስት ‘women’ + -ሂ ‘also’. ጾራ is the 3fp perfect (feminine plural, ending -ኣ) ‘they (f.) carried’; ምጽዋረ is the construct of ምጽዋር, here ‘the carrying, the burden’ (?). ኢይትሀጐላ is the 3fp imperfect of the tä-stem of ሀጐለ ‘perish’, ‘they will not be lost’. ንጹሓተ is the plural of ንጹሕ ‘pure’ in the accusative (predicate); ይከውና is 3fp imperfect of ኮነ. በይእቲ ባሕርይ = በ- ‘in’ + ይእቲ ‘she’ + ባሕርይ in apposition, ‘in her, the pearl’ (the ይእቲ resumes the noun, as in ch. 68 part 1). ወባቲ = ወ- + በ- + -ቲ ‘her’, ‘and by her’; ትትቄደሱ is the 2mp imperfect of a tä-stem, ‘you are sanctified’ (ቀደሰ ‘be holy’), and ወትነጽሑ the 2mp imperfect of the simple stem of ነጽሐ ‘be clean’, ‘you become clean’.

sentences.n: በእንቲአሃ = በእንተ ‘on account of’ with the 3fs suffix -ሃ (stem በእንቲአ-), ‘for her sake’; ወበእንተ ጽዮን ‘and for Zion’. ፈጠሮ = ፈጠረ ‘created’ + -ኦ ‘it’, with ለኵሉ ዓለም ‘all the world’ repeating the object (ለ- marks the object here). Zion and the pearl are named together as the two reasons for creation: Zion is the Ark (ታቦት), and the pearl is the line of the saviour.

sentences.i: As for Zion, she stayed with your firstborn and will be the salvation of the people of Ethiopia for ever; and the pearl was carried into the womb of Jeroboam, your son, and will be salvation for the whole world;
sentences.n: ጽዮንሰ = ጽዮን + the emphatic/contrastive -ሰ: ‘as for Zion’, set against the pearl, ‘and the pearl, for her part’ (ባሕርይኒ, with -ኒ ‘also’). The contrast is the point of the chapter: Zion goes to Menelik, the firstborn, to Ethiopia, while the pearl goes to another son. ወትከውን is 3fs ‘she will be’, agreeing with Zion. ለሕዝበ ኢትዮጵያ = ለ- ‘for’ + ሕዝበ ‘people of’ (construct) + ኢትዮጵያ. ለዓለም after እስከ ‘until’ is the idiom ‘for ever’. ተጸውረት is the passive 3fs perfect of ጾረ ‘carry’, ‘she was carried’ (a perfect for what is already decided). አዮር ፡ በዓም is printed as two words by a wordspace; it is the name ኢዮርብዓም ‘Jeroboam’ written in a variant form, which I read as one name (?); the next units spell it ኢዮርብዓም. Bezold’s text gives Jeroboam for Solomon’s son where 1 Kings 12 has Rehoboam; I keep the name as written.

sentences.l: for when reached his-age, she-will-be-born from-your-seed she the-pearl, for pure exceedingly sevenfold (?) than sun;
sentences.i: for when his time arrives (?), she will be born of your seed, that pearl, for she is far purer, seven times over (?), than the sun;
sentences.n: እስመ introduces the reason for the pearl’s reaching the world through Jeroboam’s line. በጽሐ is the 3ms perfect ‘reached’ and ዕድሜሁ ‘his age, his time’ is its subject; the -ሁ ‘his’ is masculine although ባሕርይ is treated as feminine (ይእቲ, ንጽሕት), so the owner of the ‘age’ is not certain: perhaps the saviour’s, perhaps a loose reference to the pearl (?). ትትወለድ is 3fs imperfect of the tä-stem of ወለደ, ‘she will be born’. ምስብዒተ is the crux of this unit: the form looks like a noun or adverb from ሰብዐ ‘seven’ (‘sevenfold’, accusative), which would read ‘seven times (purer) than the sun’ and fits Isaiah 30:26 (‘the light of the sun will be sevenfold’); I take it so (?) but cannot confirm the word in the lexicon. እምነ ፀሐይ = እምነ ‘than’ (comparative እም- before a noun) + ፀሐይ ‘sun’; ፈድፋደ ‘exceedingly’.

sentences.i: and a saviour will come from the throne of his divinity, and will dwell upon her, and will put on her flesh;
sentences.n: The incarnation, put in the pearl’s language. እመንበረ = እም- ‘from’ + መንበረ ‘throne of’ (construct of መንበር); መለኮቱ is መለኮት ‘divinity, godhead’ + -ሁ ‘his’, so ‘the throne of his divinity’, a construct chain with a suffix at the end. ይመጽእ and ወየኀድር are 3ms imperfects (መጽአ ‘come’, ኀደረ ‘dwell’); ላዕሌሃ ‘upon her’ recalls the Annunciation (Luke 1:35, ‘the power of the Most High will overshadow you’), though the Geʿez verb is ‘dwell’. ይለብስ ‘he puts on’ (ለብሰ ‘put on, be clothed’), ሥጋሃ ‘her flesh’ (the flesh is Mary’s, as the pearl’s end-point).

sentences.i: And now, you yourself will tell of her; my lord and your lord has said to me (?). I am Gabriel, the angel, the guardian of you who carry her, the pearl, from the womb of Adam to the womb of Hannah, to keep you from servitude and uncleanness wherever the pearl dwells;
sentences.n: The speaker is an angel and he now names himself as Gabriel (the same speaker as ‘the angel’ of ch. 67–68 part 1, I take it (?)). The sentence is compressed and the order of speech is uncertain (?): I read ወአሜሃኒ ለሊከ ትዜንዋ as ‘and now, you yourself will tell of her’ (ትዜንዋ = 2ms imperfect of ዜነወ ‘tell, announce’ + -ዋ ‘her’), and ይቤለኒ እግዚእየ ወእግዚእከ as the angel’s aside, ‘my lord and your lord told me’, the Lord being the one who sends him. ወአሜሃኒ = ወ- + አሜሃ ‘now’ + -ኒ ‘also’. ለእለ ትጸውር ፡ ዋ is the crux: ትጸውር and ዋ are divided by a wordspace; I read them as one word ትጸውርዋ, the 2mp imperfect ትጸውሩ ‘you carry’ + -ዋ ‘her’ (the -ሩ + -ዋ coalesces to -ርዋ, as ጾርክምዋ in part 1), with ለባሕርይ repeating the object: ‘you who carry her, the pearl’. ዐቃቢክሙ = ዐቃቢ ‘guardian’ + -ክሙ ‘your’ (plural). Gabriel with Michael and Uriel are the three guardian angels of the three sons (see the next units). እምከርሠ … ወእስከ ከርሠ ‘from the womb of … to the womb of’: ከርሠ is the construct of ከርሥ ‘womb’. ሐና is Hannah, the wife of Joachim, the last carrier named in part 1. ከመ እክላእክሙ = ከመ + 1cs subjunctive of ከለአ ‘keep back, protect’ + -ክሙ ‘you’. እምግብርናት ‘from servitudes’ (plural of ግብርና) (?). ኀበ ተኀድር ባሕርይ: ኀበ ‘where’ + 3fs imperfect ‘she dwells’.

sentences.n: ዕፀ ሳቤቅ ‘tree of Sabek’: ዕፀ is the construct of ዕፅ ‘tree, wood’. ሳቤቅ is the word of Genesis 22:13 in the Greek-based Geʿez Bible (LXX σαβεκ, Hebrew sĕbak ‘thicket’), the thicket in which Abraham’s ram was caught; the tree there is the type of the cross, so here ‘the tree of Sabek’ is the wood that will become the cross. I take it so (?). ይሜግብ is irregular: the stem looks like መገበ ‘feed’ but the vowel after ሜ is unusual; I read it as ‘he tends, feeds’ (nourishes the tree until the time) (?). እንተ ትከውን = ‘which will be’ (fem. relative + 3fs imperfect). መስቀሎ ለመድኅን ‘his cross, the saviour’s’: a suffix first, then ለ- + the owner. Uriel is the third of the angels.

sentences.n: ወበደኃሪ = ወ- + በ- + ደኃሪ ‘the last, the end’, ‘and in the end, afterwards’. ይነሥኦ ለዕፀ መስቀል = 3ms imperfect of ነሥአ ‘take, take up’ + -ኦ ‘it’, with ለዕፀ መስቀል ‘the tree of the cross’ repeating the object (ዕፀ construct, መስቀል ‘cross’). ዘርአ አድራሚስ ‘seed of Adramis’: ዘርአ is the construct, so the descendants of Adramis, not Adramis himself, take the cross. አድራሚስ is the same name as አድራሚ below (the youngest son); the final -ስ is probably a Greek-style ending or a scribal addition (?). The numeral ፫ stands after ወልድከ and is not a normal part of the sentence: I read it as ‘third’, because the sons are three (David, Jeroboam, Adrami; the next three units) (?); the alternative is a stray numeral in the transmission. መድኀኒተ is the construct before the relative clause, ‘(the cross) of the saviour who was sent’ (compare መድኀኒተ ደቂቅከ in the last words of the angel); ዘተፈነወ = ዘ- ‘who’ + tä-stem perfect of ፈነወ ‘send’, ‘who was sent’; ዲበ ምድር ‘upon the earth’.

sentences.i: The angel Michael is with Zion, together with David, your firstborn son, who took the throne of David your father;
sentences.n: There is no verb: ‘(is) with’ is understood, and the three angels are assigned to the three sons in turn. ኀበ ጽዮን ‘with Zion, at Zion’ (ኀበ ‘to, with, at’). ምስለ ዳዊት ወልድከ በኵርከ: ‘David’ here is the young prince Menelik, styled David (ch. 66–67), who takes Zion to Ethiopia, and he is the ‘firstborn’. ዘነሥአ ‘who took’ is the perfect of ነሥአ; ‘who has taken’ or ‘who will take’ is equally possible, because the angel is speaking of what is already decided. መንበረ ዳዊት አቡከ ‘throne of David your father’: a construct chain, መንበረ ‘throne of’ with ዳዊት, and አቡከ = አብ ‘father’ + -ከ ‘your’ (a possessive suffix after the owner, in apposition).

sentences.l: And-this when he-heard he-was-strengthened in-his-bed and-he-bowed-down to-angel-of God and-said: I-thank God, my-lord, and-your-lord, O luminous spiritual-one, who made-me-hear word who gladdens-me, who not he-cuts-off her (?), my-soul, on-account-of my-sin, from-inheritance-of my-fathers; who received my-repentance after my-distress, who regarded my-tears and-heard my-wailing, who saw my-distress and-did-not-leave-me, my-grief, (that)-I-die, but gladdened-me before goes-out my-soul from-my-body;
sentences.i: And when he heard this, he took strength on his bed and bowed down to the angel of God, and said: “I thank God, my lord and your lord; O luminous one, spiritual one, you who made me hear a word that gladdens me, a word that does not cut off my soul (?) from the inheritance of my fathers because of my sin; who received my repentance after my distress, who looked upon my tears and heard my wailing, who saw my distress and did not leave me to die in my grief, but gladdened me before my soul goes out from my body;
sentences.n: This is Solomon’s thanksgiving, the start of his psalm-like reply, and the longest unit of the part: it has no ፤ at which to cut. ወዘንተ ሶበ ሰምዐ ‘and when he heard this’; ተኀየለ is the 3ms perfect of the tä-stem of ኀየለ ‘be strong’, ‘he took strength, he was strengthened’; ምስካቡ ‘his bed’. ወሰገደ ለመልአከ እግዚኣብሔር ‘and bowed to the angel of God’ (ሰገደ + ለ-, then መልአከ ‘angel of’, construct). ኣአኵቶ is written ኣ-, the 1cs imperfect of አኰተ ‘give thanks’ + -ኦ ‘him’, with ለእግዚኣብሔር repeating the object. ወለእ ፡ ግዚእከ is one word split by a wordspace, ወለእግዚእከ ‘and to your lord’; it is a second object of the thanks, ‘to my lord and to your lord’, i.e. God (Solomon calls him the lord of both himself and the angel). ኦብርሃናዊ መንፈሳዊ: ኦ ‘O’ + ብርሃናዊ ‘of light, luminous’ + መንፈሳዊ ‘spiritual’, addressed to the angel (the phrase can, less likely, address God (?)). ዘአስማዕከኒ = ዘ- ‘who’ + 2ms perfect of the causative of ሰምዐ ‘hear’, ‘you made me hear’ + -ኒ ‘me’; the relative clauses that follow (ዘያስተፈሥሐኒ ‘which gladdens me’) qualify ቃለ ‘a word’. ዘኢይሜቊሳ is uncertain (?): I read the verb as ‘cut off, deprive’ with the last radical and the suffix -ኣ ‘her’ written together as ሳ; the meaning is a guess from the context, which I cannot check in the lexicon (?), resumed by ለነፍስየ ‘my soul’, and ‘from the inheritance of my fathers’ (እምርስተ አበውየ = እም- ‘from’ + ርስት ‘inheritance’, construct, + አበውየ ‘my fathers’), so that the word does not cut Solomon’s soul off from his fathers’ portion (?); this suits the end of the speech, where his soul is to be with David, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. The verbs ተወክፈ ‘received’, ነጸረ ‘looked at, regarded’, ሰምዐ ‘heard’, ርእየ ‘saw’ are 3ms perfects in relative clauses (ዘ-) describing God’s past favour; ንስሓየ ‘my repentance’, ምንዳቤየ ‘my distress’, አንብዕየ ‘my tears’, ገዓርየ ‘my wailing’, ትኩዝየ ‘my grief, anguish’ (?). ወኢኀደገኒ ትኩዝየ እሞት is read ‘did not leave me, in my grief, to die’ (እሞት = 1cs subjunctive of ሞተ, ‘that I die’) (?). ዘእንበለ ትፃእ ነፍስየ = ‘before (lit. ‘without’) my soul goes out’, ዘእንበለ + 3fs subjunctive.

sentences.l: From-now-indeed not-grieves-me death, and-I-love-it like life; from-now-indeed I-will-drink-down the-cup-of death bitter like honey; from-now-indeed I-will-love-her, the-grave, like dwelling, of-in slabs (?).
sentences.i: From now on death does not grieve me, and I love it as I love life; from now on I will drink down the cup of death, bitter though it is, as if it were honey; from now on I will love the grave as a dwelling, one of slabs (?).
sentences.n: እምይእዜሰ = እም- ‘from’ + ይእዜ ‘now’ + the emphatic -ሰ, ‘from now on’, repeated three times as the speech builds. ኢያሐዝነኒ ‘does not grieve me’ (the same verb as ኢታሕዝን in the angel’s last words, with -ኒ ‘me’). ወኣፈቅሮ ‘and I love him/it’ (ኣ- is the 1cs imperfect of አፍቀረ + -ኦ ‘it’, as ኣፈቅራ + -ኣ ‘her’ later). እሰርቦ = the 1cs imperfect of ሰርበ ‘swallow, drink down’ + -ኦ ‘it’ (?). ለጽዋዐ ሞት ‘the cup of death’ (construct, ለ- marking the object); መሪር ‘bitter’; the cup of death recalls the cup of Gethsemane (Matthew 26:39) only loosely. ከመ መዓር ‘like honey’. ለመቃብር ‘the grave’ (ለ- marking the object). ከመ ማኅደር ዘበ ፡ አፍራጽ is the crux: ዘበ ፡ አፍራጽ is divided by a wordspace, so ዘበአፍራጽ ‘which is of/with slabs (?)’. I take አፍራጽ as a plural ‘slabs, pieces’ (the tomb as a dwelling built of slabs), but the word is not confirmed in the lexicon and the printed division may be wrong (?).

sentences.i: And even if I go down into the lowest of the low, the depths of Sheol, which is for my sin — what is that to me (?);
sentences.n: The unit has a protasis, and the main clause could be carried over from the previous unit (‘it does not grieve me’); I read the rhetorical question at its end as the main clause. መትሕተ ታሕቲት ‘below the lowest’, the lowest depth: መትሕተ is the accusative of መትሕት ‘below’, ታሕቲት ‘lowest’ (fem.), and መዓምቅተ is the construct of መዓምቅት ‘depths’ (so ‘the depths of Sheol’, compare Psalm 88:6). ዘበእንተ አበሳየ ‘that (is) on account of my sin’. ሚላዕሌየ is the crux of this unit: I read ሚ ‘what?’ + ላዕሌየ ‘upon me’ (ላዕል ‘upon’ + -የ ‘me’, with the suffix stem ላዕሌ-), ‘what is it to me?’, a rhetorical question standing as the main clause (?). The alternative is a corrupt word in the edition (?). The line is the least secure of the speech.

sentences.i: And my soul will be with the soul of David my father, and with the soul of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, my fathers; and the saviour will come and bring us out of Sheol, with all my fathers and my kin, the earlier ones and the later ones; and for my sons too, on the earth, there are three mighty angels who guard them;
sentences.n: The hope of Solomon, his fathers’ company: ወትከውን ነፍስየ ‘and my soul will be’, with the third-person feminine verb agreeing with ነፍስ ‘soul’ (feminine). ምስለ ነፍሰ ዳዊት ‘with the soul of David’ (ነፍሰ construct). ወይመጽእ መድኅን ወያወፅአነ እምሲኦል ‘and the saviour will come and bring us out of Sheol’: ያወፅአነ = ያወፅእ ‘he brings out’ (causative of ወፅአ) + -ነ ‘us’, the harrowing of Hell; the Geʿez expects Christ to bring the righteous dead out. ቀደምት ወደኀርት ‘former and later’, plural adjectives qualifying ወአዝማድየ ‘my kin’ (ዘመድ ‘kin’, plural አዝማድ + -የ) (?). ወለደቂቅየኒ = ወ- + ለ- + ደቂቅየ ‘my sons’ + -ኒ ‘also’. ፫ here is the spoken ሠለስቱ ‘three’ before መላእክት ‘angels’ (the three of the angels, Gabriel, Michael, Uriel). ኀያላን ‘mighty ones’, እለ የዐቅብዎሙ ‘who guard them’ (የዐቅብ ‘he guards’, ዐቀበ; 3mp imperfect + -ሆሙ).

sentences.i: Who is like God, the merciful, who has mercy and spares his handiwork (?), who forgives the sin of wrongdoers and does not blot out the memory of the penitent;
sentences.n: መኑ ከመ እግዚኣብሔር ‘who is like God?’ echoes Micah 7:18 (‘who is a God like you, pardoning iniquity?’; compare Exodus 15:11). መሓሪ ‘merciful’ is the agent noun of ምሕረ ‘have mercy’; ዘይምሕር ‘who has mercy’ (3ms imperfect). ወይምሕክ ተግባሮ is uncertain (?): the verb looks like ምሕከ, which I take as a variant of ‘spare’ from the context, and ተግባሮ is ተግባር ‘work, deed’ + -ኦ ‘his’ (the suffix -ሁ in its form after a consonant), which I read as the work of his hands, his creatures (?). ዘይሰሪ ‘who forgives’ (ሰረየ ‘forgive’), አበሳ ‘sin’ with ለመአብሳን ‘to the wrongdoers’ (ለ- here marking the one who sins; ‘the sin of the sinners’ is also possible). ኢያጠፍእ is the 3ms negated subjunctive/imperfect of አጠፍአ ‘extinguish, blot out’; ዝክረ ‘memory of’ (construct), ነሳሕያን ‘penitents’ (plural of ነሳሒ).

glossary.አዮር: ኢዮርብዓም — Jeroboam, first half of the name, split in the edition (አዮር በዓም) (proper name)
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
glossary.አድራሚ: አድራሚ — Adrami (?) (name of a son of Solomon (?); form obscure, possibly corrupt) (?)
glossary.አድራሚስ: አድራሚስ — Adramis (proper name; a son of Solomon, cf. አድራሚ) (?)
glossary.ኢያሐዝነኒ: አሕዘነ — it does not grieve me (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, causative A-stem of ሐዝነ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ኢይትሀጐላ: ተሀጕለ — they (f.) will not be lost (ኢ- 'not' + 3fp imperfect, tä-stem passive of ሀጕለ 'perish')
glossary.ኣአኵቶ: አኰተ — I give thanks to him, praise (1cs imperfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him'; written ኣአኵቶ)
glossary.ኣፈቅራ: አፍቀረ — I love her (1cs imperfect, causative A-stem, spelled ኣ-, + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.እመንበረ: መንበር — from the throne of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምሥጋየ: ሥጋ — from my body (እም- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.እምርስተ: ርስት — from the inheritance of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምብዝኀ: ብዝኅ — from the abundance of (እም- 'from' + noun ብዝኅ 'multitude', construct ብዝኀ)
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምከርሠ: ከርሥ — from the womb of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምዘርእከ: ዘርእ — from your seed (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — from now on, indeed (እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.እምግብርናት: ግብርና — from servitudes (እም- + plural ግብርናት; abstract) (?)
glossary.እሞት: ሞተ — I die (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G, m-w-t)
glossary.እሰርቦ: ሰርበ — I will drink down, gulp (?) (1cs imperfect, G + -ኦ '3ms it') (?)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?)
glossary.እክላእክሙ: ከለአ — I may keep, guard you (1cs subjunctive, G, k-l-ʾ + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
glossary.ኦብርሃናዊ: ብርሃናዊ — O luminous one, of light (ኦ vocative + adjective from ብርሃን 'light')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኵለንታሁ: ኵለንታ — all of him, his whole self (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወለእ: እግዚእ — and to (the) lord, the first part of ወለእግዚእከ 'and to your lord' (ወ- + ለ- + እግዚእ), split by the wordspace in the edition
glossary.ወለደቂቅየኒ: ወልድ — and for my sons also (ወ- + ለ- + plural ደቂቅ of ወልድ + -የ '1cs my' + -ኒ 'also')

glossary.ወረከብኩ: ረከበ — and I found (ወ- + 1cs perfect, G)
glossary.ወረድኩ: ወረደ — I went down, go down (1cs perfect, G, w-r-d; conditional after ወእመኒ 'even if')
glossary.ወርኵስ: ርኵስ — and uncleanness, impurity (ወ- + noun/adjective ርኩስ 'unclean')
glossary.ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — and in the latter, last
glossary.ወባሕርይኒ: ባሕርይ — and the pearl also (ወ- + noun + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወባቲ: በ — and by it, with it (ወ- + preposition በ + -ቲ '3fs', ባቲ)
glossary.ወተወረውኩ: ተወርወ — and I was thrown (ወ- + 1cs perfect, passive tä-stem of ወረወ 'throw')
glossary.ወትነጽሑ: ነጽሐ — and you (mp) become clean (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, G, n-ṣ-ḥ, intransitive 'be clean')
glossary.ወትከውን: ኮነ — and you will be (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, k-w-n; the same letters could be 3fs 'she', see the unit note) · 3fs 'and she/it will be' agreeing with ምድር (ወትከውን ሎቱ ዛቲ ምድር 'and this land will be his')
glossary.ወንጽሕት: ንጹሕ — and pure (ወ- + adjective, fem. sg.)
glossary.ወአመ: አመ — and when, on the day that (ወ- + conjunction/preposition)
glossary.ወአሜሃኒ: አሜሃ — and now also (ወ- + adverb አሜሃ 'then, now' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአንስትሂ: ብእሲት — and women also (ወ- + plural አንስት of ብእሲት 'woman' + -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወአዝማድየ: ዘመድ — and my kin (ወ- + plural አዝማድ + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወኡርኤል: ኡርኤል — and Uriel (ወ- + proper name; spelled ኡርኤል)
glossary.ወኡርያልኒ: ኡርያል — and Uriel also (ወ- + proper name + -ኒ 'also'; spelled ኡርያል)
glossary.ወኢታሕዝን: አሕዘነ — and do not grieve, sadden (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 2ms jussive, causative A-stem of ሐዝነ 'be sad'; ኢታሕዝን ልበከ 'do not sadden your heart')
glossary.ወኢኀደገኒ: ኀደገ — and did not leave me (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወኢያጠፍእ: አጠፍአ — and he does not blot out (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, causative A-stem of ጠፍአ)
glossary.ወኣፈቅሮ: አፍቀረ — and I love it (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, causative A-stem, spelled ኣ- + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.ወእግዚእከ: እግዚእ — and your lord (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወኵለንታሁ: ኵለንታ — and all of him, wholly (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወዘረወኒ: ዘርወ — and he scattered me (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, z-r-w + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወየኀድር: ኀደረ — and he will dwell (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-d-r)
glossary.ወየኀፍሩ: ኀፈረ — and they will be ashamed (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ḫ-f-r)
glossary.ወያወፅአነ: አውፅአ — and he will bring us out (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative A-stem of ወጽአ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወይለብስ: ለብሰ — and he will put on, wear (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, l-b-s)
glossary.ወይመጽእ: መጽአ — and he will come (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወይምሕክ: ምሕከ — and he spares (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect; form and lexical meaning uncertain, perhaps related to ምሕረ) (?)
glossary.ወደኀርት: ደኃሪ — and the later ones (ወ- + adjective, plural ደኀርት)

glossary.ዕድሜሁ: ዕድሜ — his age, appointed time (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; masculine suffix though the pearl is fem.) (?)
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')

glossary.ዘተወክፈ: ተወክፈ — who received (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem, w-k-f)
glossary.ዘተፈነወ: ተፈነወ — who was sent (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive tä-stem of ፈነወ 'send')

glossary.ዘነጸረ: ነጸረ — who looked, regarded (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, n-ṣ-r)
glossary.ዘአስማዕከኒ: አስማዐ — who made me hear (ዘ- relative + 2ms perfect, causative A-stem of ሰምዐ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘኢመቈሳ: መቈሰ — which did not cut off, deprive her (?) (ዘ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her'; lexical meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘኢይሜቊሳ: መቈሰ — which does not cut off, deprive her (?) (ዘ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect + -ኣ '3fs her'; lexical meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘያስተፈሥሐኒ: አስተፈሥሐ — who gladdens me (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, causative-reflexive of ፈሥሐ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘይምሕር: ምሕረ — who is merciful (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ḥ-r)
glossary.ዘይሰሪ: ሰረየ — who forgives (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, s-r-y)
glossary.ዘይንእስ: ንእሰ — who is younger, small (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, n-ʾ-s)
glossary.ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.የዐቅብዎሙ: ዐቀበ — they guard them (3mp imperfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይመግባ: መገበ — that he may feed her (3ms subjunctive, G, m-g-b + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ይሜግብ: መገበ — he tends, feeds (?) (3ms imperfect, form obscure, perhaps from መገበ 'feed') (?)
glossary.ይቤለኒ: ብህለ — he said to me (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ለኒ 'to me')
glossary.ይነሥኦ: ነሥአ — he will take it (3ms imperfect, G, n-ś-ʾ + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይከውና: ኮነ — they (f.) will be (3fp imperfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ይደሉ: ደለወ — be fitting, be due (3ms imperfect)
glossary.ይድብይዎ: ደበየ — that they hide him/it (3mp subjunctive + -ዎ '3ms him, it'; lemma and meaning reconstructed from the form and the context) (?)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ግዚእከ: እግዚእ — lord, your lord (noun, the rest of እግዚእ split from ወለእ + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ጠሰየኒ: ጠሰየ — he seized, took hold of me (?) (3ms perfect + -ኒ '1cs me'; lexical meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ጻድቃነ: ጻድቅ — righteous (adjective, plural ጻድቃን, accusative ጻድቃነ, predicate)
glossary.ጾራ: ጾረ — they (f.) carried (3fp perfect, G, ṣ-w-r)
glossary.ፈጠሮ: ፈጠረ — he created it (3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms it')
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine · after a noun, 'third' (ወልድከ ፫ 'your third son'), the spoken ordinal ሣልስ (śalləs) (?)
